name: ComboChart
label: Combo chart
description: Bar and line series in one chart, with an optional second y-axis for pairs in different units, like spend and ROAS.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the values, tooltips and value axis are written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: xKey
props.description: Key in data for x-axis values

props.name: barKey
props.description: Key in data for the bar series

props.name: barLabel
props.description: Display name for the bar series, shown in the tooltip; defaults to the key

props.name: lineKey
props.description: Key in data for the line series

props.name: lineLabel
props.description: Display name for the line series, shown in the tooltip; defaults to the key

props.name: barColor
props.description: Bar fill colour (CSS value or token reference)

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Line stroke colour (CSS value or token reference)

props.name: secondaryAxis
props.description: Plot the line on its own right-hand y-axis, for series in different units

props.name: title
props.description:
Chart title, in the shared chart header; it also names the figure.
Note: this replaces the native `title` tooltip attribute, which the chart does not expose.

props.name: summaryItems
props.description: Summary stats displayed in the header

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (border, padding, fill) when the chart sits inside another panel that supplies the surface

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the wrapper
